host_about:
We proudly offer you a boutique selection of Rooms, Suites, Apartments and Cottages (many with water views) in beautiful, historic, Williamstown.

Rooms & Suites
Our lovely old home is just one door from the water, boat marina and restaurants and has been tastefully renovated and decorated so that every room has ensuites (some with spas) and most of the rooms also have gas log fires. One of the rooms has its own private lounge and balcony but other guests can enjoy the shared lounge room with fire and bay window.  

Apartments & Cottages
The apartments and cottages that we offer are dotted around Williamstown and most are an easy walk to the restaurants, yacht-clubs and shops. They vary from 1-4 bedrooms and 1-3 bathrooms. (One apartment even has a 4th toilet). 

We are not just offering a spare room in our house. This is our business and we are a dedicated team working to ensure that your stay is comfortable.  We are very careful about the apartments and cottages that we choose to take on and have refused many from owners wanting us to manage them.

Having said that, Williamstown is the oldest suburb in Melbourne and therefore some of the classic older apartments have décor such as shower over the bath. Whilst I would normally say no to venues like this, there are two apartments that have this but their other qualities so far outweigh that one negative and I quietly chip away at the owners in order for that to be changed.  I mention this because we want you to let us know if you have mobility issues so that we can suggest other venues for you. 

Other than beds (which are purchased to order and very comfortable!!), I love to buy antique and pre-loved furniture to fit certain venues and I have them restored using classic and sometimes quirky fabrics so you will not find a ‘hotel’ feel to our venues. Each one is quite different (some are Modern, some Victorian and some are Art-deco era). 

Re Dining: 

Breakfast: We provide a breakfast basket to guests staying in the apartments and cottages. Sadly due to restrictions related to covid, we do not currently offer breakfast in the main house so have reduced prices accordingly and our house-guests enjoy very good breakfasts in one of our many local cafes / restaurants, all within 2-4 minutes of here. (There are three places that we particularly recommend for a great breakfast).   There is however a table set in the bay window and you are welcome to use (Email hidden by Airbnb) plementary Tea, coffee and biscuits are provided in all venues. 

Dinner: There is an excellent choice of restaurants with a variety of cuisines all within walking distance to nearly all of the venues that we offer. 

I'm proud to say that we have won the last 7 awards for 'tourism' and/or 'hospitality' at the Hobsons Bay region Business excellence awards as well as taken out the People's Choice award for the state of Victoria twice in the last three awards. 

Most of our guests are businesspeople or travellers so you can be assured of a quiet, relaxing and private 'home award from home' experience. We want your accommodation to be comfortable and check-ins and check-outs easy so that you can get on with enjoying the reason that you are here.

We look forward to welcoming you to beautiful Williamstown. 

Best regards, 

Melissa and the team from Captains Retreat

host_about:
We proudly offer you a boutique selection of Rooms, Suites, Apartments and Cottages (many with water views) in beautiful, historic, Williamstown.

Rooms & Suites
Our lovely old home is just one door from the water, boat marina and restaurants and has been tastefully renovated and decorated so that every room has ensuites (some with spas) and most of the rooms also have gas log fires. One of the rooms has its own private lounge and balcony but other guests can enjoy the shared lounge room with fire and bay window.  

Apartments & Cottages
The apartments and cottages that we offer are dotted around Williamstown and most are an easy walk to the restaurants, yacht-clubs and shops. They vary from 1-4 bedrooms and 1-3 bathrooms. (One apartment even has a 4th toilet). 

We are not just offering a spare room in our house. This is our business and we are a dedicated team working to ensure that your stay is comfortable.  We are very careful about the apartments and cottages that we choose to take on and have refused many from owners wanting us to manage them.

Having said that, Williamstown is the oldest suburb in Melbourne and therefore some of the classic older apartments have décor such as shower over the bath. Whilst I would normally say no to venues like this, there are two apartments that have this but their other qualities so far outweigh that one negative and I quietly chip away at the owners in order for that to be changed. YOUR HOST: GARY COPOLOV 

Hello, my name is Gary and I live in Middle Park, Melbourne. I currently manage sixteen short to long term accommodation properties in Middle Park (6), Albert Park (3), South Melbourne (4), Port Melbourne (1), North Carlton (1), Torquay (1). Middle Park, Albert Park, South Melbourne and Port Melbourne. These are arguably some of Melbourne’s best inner city suburbs. My Airbnb hosting journey started when my wife, Jo and I bought Florence Court in Nimmo Street, Middle Park in 2015. It is a heritage listed, mid 30's Art Deco apartment block in where I now offer four  fantastic short term accommodation apartments. I now operate sixteen brilliant short to long term accommodation properties in the area ranging from apartments to houses and from one to four bedrooms. They are all stunning and fitted out to the very highest standard.

Each property has a copy of "Adventures" which provides details my recommended local To Do's and the very best of nearby dining pleasures. There are many recommendations for guests of all ages. 

Jo and I met playing tennis at Kooyong Lawn Tennis Club and were married in Paris just over 28 years ago. Jo is a part time teacher at the local primary school where she is a special education reading teacher. She has a real passion for books, real estate and interior design. A typical week will see her at a local café with friends, walking our dog in the nearby park, seeing a movie, attending her book club or a yoga class. 

We have two children. Natasha (Tash) an Architecture - Design graduate working in the construction industry. When she is not out socialising or globetrotting she may occasionally walk our friendly Nova Scotia Duck Tolling Retriever called Hudson. We love pets and welcome them at all properties. 

Our son Louis lives in Portland, Maine, USA where he works for the Boston Celtics basketball team as Player Manager of their second team the Maine Celtics.  He attended university in Boston, USA and represented Australia in rowing as a coxswain. 

On weekends, given a chance, we will visit a beach side holiday apartment with stunning sea views in Torquay. Torquay is just over an hour’s drive from Melbourne. host_about:
Misty Woods retreat was born as an idea back in January 2014 when we have decided to turn things around.

The house was looking very tired, so an idea of turning it into something new and exciting really appealed to us.  Jeff is an architectural designer by trade (director of 11 Dimensions Pty.Ltd), so any kind of renovations always excite him. The existing house had one big bedroom downstairs, another 2 tiny bedrooms with large old wardrobes, combined bathroom and laundry. After careful planning and several considerations we have introduced second bathroom with a shower and created a feature master bedroom with its own en-suite.

We really wanted to capitalise on views available from the property. We have always envisaged a large bath with views all around. Being able to open up the en-suite to the bedroom creates a larger and more usable space without the need to congregate the spaces. Because of the existing building envelope the second bathroom and laundry were designed as joinery, tucked away items.

The kitchen palette was chosen carefully to integrate into the wall without standing out. The reflective mirror captures and embraces the surroundings when you are within the room even more so. The choice for green cupboards was obvious as wanted to make a further connection to the outside colours that are seen through the window above the bench.

The grey washed out oak timber floors were selected from Royal Oak floors for its natural look and feel. The idea was to make the house feel earthy and comfortable with all the features of modern amenities.

We have hand picked every single thing in the house that you may see. Bed linen and towels of the best quality from David Jones, beautiful kitchen plates, coffee machine and glasses and King furniture couch. We could not purchase anything that we did not love. Everything had to be perfect and it took time to make it all perfect. And now we are proud to hand it over to you to enjoy and appreciate our creation.

In short we absolutely love what we have created. Now we would love to hear what you think of Misty Woods retreat after you have spent some time there.

Enjoy!

Hey there you curious creatures! Time to share a little about ourselves. Mike was born and raised in New Zealand and I have a Greek background but am from a small country town in Victoria. One more thought to take with you wherever you may be...

We Travel Not To Escape Life, But For Life Not To Escape Us.

See you very soon!


Mike & Panagiota x

Hi from Bronnie and Neil ;-)
We love being airbnb hosts and sharing our homes and our beautiful city with others.
We have been airbnb hosts since 2013 and during that time we have met thousands of amazing and wonderful people from all around the world and Australia.

Best regards
Bronnie and Neil

neighborhood_overview:
Fitzroy is an eclectic suburb with a rich history etched into its old pubs and gay bars, narrow streets and terrace houses, long-lasting retailers and modern wine bars that have kept the old decor. The suburb was once long associated with the working class and was known to have a bohemian vibe but became a casualty to gentrification in the ’80s and ’90s. Yet despite undergoing urban revitalisation, many heritage buildings and Victorian-era architecture have lasted through the decades and play a key role in the area’s ambience – right next to the street art. 

You’ll find various characters within Fitzroy’s nooks, including many students, young professionals and those of the older generation that have called the community home for decades. It’s economically diverse too, having one of Melbourne’s largest public housing complexes while also putting up some of the most exxy rent in all of the city. It’s hard to pigeon hole the area but, after all, why would you want to?

description:

host_about:
We proudly offer you a boutique selection of Rooms, Suites, Apartments and Cottages (many with water views) in beautiful, historic, Williamstown.

Rooms & Suites
Our lovely old home is just one door from the water, boat marina and restaurants and has been tastefully renovated and decorated so that every room has ensuites (some with spas) and most of the rooms also have gas log fires. One of the rooms has its own private lounge and balcony but other guests can enjoy the shared lounge room with fire and bay window.  

Apartments & Cottages
The apartments and cottages that we offer are dotted around Williamstown and most are an easy walk to the restaurants, yacht-clubs and shops. They vary from 1-4 bedrooms and 1-3 bathrooms. (One apartment even has a 4th toilet). 

We are not just offering a spare room in our house. This is our business and we are a dedicated team working to ensure that your stay is comfortable.  We are very careful about the apartments and cottages that we choose to take on and have refused many from owners wanting us to manage them.

Having said that, Williamstown is the oldest suburb in Melbourne and therefore some of the classic older apartments have décor such as shower over the bath. Whilst I would normally say no to venues like this, there are two apartments that have this but their other qualities so far outweigh that one negative and I quietly chip away at the owners in order for that to be changed.  I mention this because we want you to let us know if you have mobility issues so that we can suggest other venues for you. 

Other than beds (which are purchased to order and very comfortable!!), I love to buy antique and pre-loved furniture to fit certain venues and I have them restored using classic and sometimes quirky fabrics so you will not find a ‘hotel’ feel to our venues. Each one is quite different (some are Modern, some Victorian and some are Art-deco era). 

Re Dining: 

Breakfast: We provide a breakfast basket to guests staying in the apartments and cottages. Sadly due to restrictions related to covid, we do not currently offer breakfast in the main house so have reduced prices accordingly and our house-guests enjoy very good breakfasts in one of our many local cafes / restaurants, all within 2-4 minutes of here. (There are three places that we particularly recommend for a great breakfast).   There is however a table set in the bay window and you are welcome to use (Email hidden by Airbnb) plementary Tea, coffee and biscuits are provided in all venues. 

Dinner: There is an excellent choice of restaurants with a variety of cuisines all within walking distance to nearly all of the venues that we offer. 

I'm proud to say that we have won the last 7 awards for 'tourism' and/or 'hospitality' at the Hobsons Bay region Business excellence awards as well as taken out the People's Choice award for the state of Victoria twice in the last three awards. 

Most of our guests are businesspeople or travellers so you can be assured of a quiet, relaxing and private 'home award from home' experience. We want your accommodation to be comfortable and check-ins and check-outs easy so that you can get on with enjoying the reason that you are here.

We look forward to welcoming you to beautiful Williamstown. 

Best regards, 

Melissa and the team from Captains Retreat

host_about:
YOUR HOST: GARY COPOLOV 

Hello, my name is Gary and I live in Middle Park, Melbourne. I currently manage sixteen short to long term accommodation properties in Middle Park (6), Albert Park (3), South Melbourne (4), Port Melbourne (1), North Carlton (1), Torquay (1). Middle Park, Albert Park, South Melbourne and Port Melbourne. These are arguably some of Melbourne’s best inner city suburbs. I believe I am fortunate to live and manage properties in the area and meet and host wonderful guests. 

My Airbnb hosting journey started when my wife, Jo and I bought Florence Court in Nimmo Street, Middle Park in 2015. It is a heritage listed, mid 30's Art Deco apartment block in where I now offer four  fantastic short term accommodation apartments. I now operate sixteen brilliant short to long term accommodation properties in the area ranging from apartments to houses and from one to four bedrooms. They are all stunning and fitted out to the very highest standard. 

As an Airbnb Superhost I offer my guests a concierge like service. I am an unashamed ambassador for the area where I have lived for over 30 years. Just tell me your interests and I will offer my recommendations. 

Each property has a copy of "Adventures" which provides details my recommended local To Do's and the very best of nearby dining pleasures. There are many recommendations for guests of all ages. 

Jo and I met playing tennis at Kooyong Lawn Tennis Club and were married in Paris just over 28 years ago. Jo is a part time teacher at the local primary school where she is a special education reading teacher. She has a real passion for books, real estate and interior design. A typical week will see her at a local café with friends, walking our dog in the nearby park, seeing a movie, attending her book club or a yoga class. 

We have two children. Natasha (Tash) an Architecture - Design graduate working in the construction industry. When she is not out socialising or globetrotting she may occasionally walk our friendly Nova Scotia Duck Tolling Retriever called Hudson. We love pets and welcome them at all properties. 

Our son Louis lives in Portland, Maine, USA where he works for the Boston Celtics basketball team as Player Manager of their second team the Maine Celtics.  He attended university in Boston, USA and represented Australia in rowing as a coxswain. 

On weekends, given a chance, we will visit a beach side holiday apartment with stunning sea views in Torquay. Torquay is just over an hour’s drive from Melbourne. It is Victoria's surf capital and the gateway to the famous Great Ocean Road. In Torquay, we enjoy walks, great local food, wine, the many surf beaches and the company of friends. The apartment is available for stays on Airbnb. (Sleeps 8). 

We have travelled to Europe, the Middle East, South East Asia and the USA where we have enjoyed Airbnb hospitality in England, France, Italy, Spain, Bulgaria, Croatia, Turkey, Netherlands, Denmark, Sweden and the United States. I wish to share the same pleasure and the excitement of travel with my guests. 

I am a self-employed Marketing Consultant whose consultancy, Gold Medal Marketing develops and implements winning business development programs for businesses in various industries. I have written and delivered a number of business development programs. 

I am the honorary Chairman of the Australian Patients Association (APA) which advocates, educates and supports Australian patients. The APA strives to be the voice of and for Australian patients. 

I regularly attend a local gym for regular workouts which I would be pleased to introduce to my guests. 

On weekends in Winter I watch St. Kilda, an Australian Rules Football Club as a long standing and sadly long suffering club member.

With a family of designers I am always working on some property development or creative project for myself,  family and friends.

I like to catch a movie or show and visit galleries and believing that you should “be a tourist in your own town” try get out and about to something interesting either near or far. 

I look forward to sharing the great properties which I manage and my local experience with my guests. 

I am available to ensure that you have a great stay. 

Your host, 

Gary Copolov.

neighborhood_overview:
Separated from the CBD by Melbourne’s sporting precinct, this area along the Birrarung (Yarra River) was a gathering place for members of the Kulin Nation long before the stadiums were erected. There are three distinct vibes here: Victoria Street is Melbourne’s go-to destination for Vietnamese food; Bridge Road is known for its factory outlets, both fashion and furniture; and Swan Street brims with some of the suburb’s best restaurants and cafés. And Richmond is home to one of Melbourne’s most beloved live music institutions, the Corner Hotel. It’s also a very community-minded suburb, with the Richmond Churches Food Centre distributing much-needed food to anyone who needs it for the past 30 years – including all through Melbourne’s lockdowns. Yarra Council, which includes Richmond, was one of the first local governments in the world to declare a climate emergency, and has committed to an ambitious plan to make the suburb greener for good.

host_about:
YOUR HOST: GARY COPOLOV 

Hello, my name is Gary and I live in Middle Park, Melbourne. I currently manage sixteen short to long term accommodation properties in Middle Park (6), Albert Park (3), South Melbourne (4), Port Melbourne (1), North Carlton (1), Torquay (1). Middle Park, Albert Park, South Melbourne and Port Melbourne. These are arguably some of Melbourne’s best inner city suburbs. I believe I am fortunate to live and manage properties in the area and meet and host wonderful guests. 

My Airbnb hosting journey started when my wife, Jo and I bought Florence Court in Nimmo Street, Middle Park in 2015. It is a heritage listed, mid 30's Art Deco apartment block in where I now offer four  fantastic short term accommodation apartments. I now operate sixteen brilliant short to long term accommodation properties in the area ranging from apartments to houses and from one to four bedrooms. They are all stunning and fitted out to the very highest standard. 

As an Airbnb Superhost I offer my guests a concierge like service. I am an unashamed ambassador for the area where I have lived for over 30 years. Just tell me your interests and I will offer my recommendations. 

Each property has a copy of "Adventures" which provides details my recommended local To Do's and the very best of nearby dining pleasures. There are many recommendations for guests of all ages. 

Jo and I met playing tennis at Kooyong Lawn Tennis Club and were married in Paris just over 28 years ago. Jo is a part time teacher at the local primary school where she is a special education reading teacher. She has a real passion for books, real estate and interior design. A typical week will see her at a local café with friends, walking our dog in the nearby park, seeing a movie, attending her book club or a yoga class. 

We have two children. Natasha (Tash) an Architecture - Design graduate working in the construction industry. When she is not out socialising or globetrotting she may occasionally walk our friendly Nova Scotia Duck Tolling Retriever called Hudson. We love pets and welcome them at all properties. 

Our son Louis lives in Portland, Maine, USA where he works for the Boston Celtics basketball team as Player Manager of their second team the Maine Celtics.  He attended university in Boston, USA and represented Australia in rowing as a coxswain. 

On weekends, given a chance, we will visit a beach side holiday apartment with stunning sea views in Torquay. Torquay is just over an hour’s drive from Melbourne. It is Victoria's surf capital and the gateway to the famous Great Ocean Road. In Torquay, we enjoy walks, great local food, wine, the many surf beaches and the company of friends. The apartment is available for stays on Airbnb. (Sleeps 8). 

We have travelled to Europe, the Middle East, South East Asia and the USA where we have enjoyed Airbnb hospitality in England, France, Italy, Spain, Bulgaria, Croatia, Turkey, Netherlands, Denmark, Sweden and the United States. I wish to share the same pleasure and the excitement of travel with my guests. 

I am a self-employed Marketing Consultant whose consultancy, Gold Medal Marketing develops and implements winning business development programs for businesses in various industries. I have written and delivered a number of business development programs. 

I am the honorary Chairman of the Australian Patients Association (APA) which advocates, educates and supports Australian patients. The APA strives to be the voice of and for Australian patients. 

I regularly attend a local gym for regular workouts which I would be pleased to introduce to my guests. 

On weekends in Winter I watch St. Kilda, an Australian Rules Football Club as a long standing and sadly long suffering club member.

With a family of designers I am always working on some property development or creative project for myself,  family and friends.

I like to catch a movie or show and visit galleries and believing that you should “be a tourist in your own town” try get out and about to something interesting either near or far. 

I look forward to sharing the great properties which I manage and my local experience with my guests. 

I am available to ensure that you have a great stay. 

Your host, 

Gary Copolov.

description:
Bordering Collingwood, The Warehouse was originally a shoe factory about 100 years ago. The space has transformed with our renovation efforts and still shows signs of its former life with its press tin loft ceiling.

Graffiti is a theme in The Warehouse and you will find local street artists' work throughout the space. The framed graffiti on the exposed brick is particularly special and goes back 20 odd years. If Melbourne street art is your thing you may be able to identify the artist...

The space
There is an open plan living space with new kitchen and dining area complete with a woodburning fireplace.

Ducted heating and aircon is available in the main area with a split system set up in the loft room.

Washing machine is located in the bathr
neighborhood_overview:
The Warehouse is in Abbotsford where you will find The Convent, which used to house nuns but is now jammed with local artists and small businesses. The grounds are perfect for strolling around and you will love the bakery. Also in Abbotsford, although you wouldn't know it by it's name, is The Collingwood Children's Farm. You can either pay to go in or take a walk on the path towards the River Yarra and you will still get a glimpse of an inner city goat or horse.

A short stroll from Victoria Park train station is the old Collingwood Football ground oval. Still full of life and sometimes there are footy events and live music.

Across Hoddle Street you will enter Collingwood which is colorful in its history and street art. Lots of little bars and food places as well as heaps of small business shops with retro, vintage and designer finds.
host_about:
Hello!  I am a well travelled Scot who has finally settled down in Melbourne as a family of 5.  

Renovating The Warehouse, from what was a commerical storage unit when purchased, into a 3 bedroom home has been a labour of love and we are delighted to be sharing it's allure with guests.

The Warehouse forms part of the developing identity of Abbotsford and Collingwood and started life on a much bigger scale as a shoe factory around 100 years ago.

Once the shoe factory closed the space was used as a ballroom attended by hard working locals on the weekend before being sub-divided into commercial units.

We have modernised The Warehouse and managed to retain the press tin ceiling and panelling in the loft room as a nod to its former life.

Graffiti is a major theme in The Warehouse and you will find local street artists' work throughout the space.   The framed graffiti on the exposed brick is particularly special and goes back 20 odd years.  If Melbourne street art is your thing you may be able to identify the now renowned artist...

We love sharing our space and are passionate about the Melbourne experience.

Questions?  Ask away and enjoy your stay.

host_about:
Hey there you curious creatures! Time to share a little about ourselves. Mike was born and raised in New Zealand and I have a Greek background but am from a small country town in Victoria. Would you believe that in all the time we’ve been together, I haven’t been able to convince Mike to do the HAKA for me? And if you're wondering, the answer is yes...he’s an ex-rugby player and All Blacks man.

Mike trained as a chef and moved to the UK in his early 20’s to work and travel through Europe. He is a Sensei, 1st Dan black belt and passionate about teaching children the art of Karate. Mike is also a qualified landscaper, is now heavily involved in property and is one of those people who’s annoyingly good at everything.

I graduated and practiced as a Podiatrist for a couple of years, before moving into the advertising industry, security risk management and recently a furniture design & importing business. We launched our hosting journey as a way to help others create unforgettable experiences during their travels whilst having the freedom to personally explore more of our amazing world at the same time!

We’re both fans of entrepreneurship, love Gary Vaynerchuck (if you’ve never heard of him, do yourself a favour and look him up) and enjoy studying personal development, online business, the sharing economy and anything that piques our interest at the time. Podcasts, Kindle, books, online courses...we love learning new things.

Thanks for stopping by. We hope the read was worth it and so look forward connecting with you as hosts or as travellers. We will do our best to make your stay truly memorable in all the right ways and also can’t wait to be great guests if we happen to chance by your Airbnb in your little corner of the globe. 

One more thought to take with you wherever you may be...

We Travel Not To Escape Life, But For Life Not To Escape Us.

See you very soon!


Mike & Panagiota x

host_about:
Hey there you curious creatures! Time to share a little about ourselves. Mike was born and raised in New Zealand and I have a Greek background but am from a small country town in Victoria. Would you believe that in all the time we’ve been together, I haven’t been able to convince Mike to do the HAKA for me? And if you're wondering, the answer is yes...he’s an ex-rugby player and All Blacks man.

Mike trained as a chef and moved to the UK in his early 20’s to work and travel through Europe. He is a Sensei, 1st Dan black belt and passionate about teaching children the art of Karate. Mike is also a qualified landscaper, is now heavily involved in property and is one of those people who’s annoyingly good at everything.

I graduated and practiced as a Podiatrist for a couple of years, before moving into the advertising industry, security risk management and recently a furniture design & importing business. We launched our hosting journey as a way to help others create unforgettable experiences during their travels whilst having the freedom to personally explore more of our amazing world at the same time!

We’re both fans of entrepreneurship, love Gary Vaynerchuck (if you’ve never heard of him, do yourself a favour and look him up) and enjoy studying personal development, online business, the sharing economy and anything that piques our interest at the time. Podcasts, Kindle, books, online courses...we love learning new things.

Thanks for stopping by. We hope the read was worth it and so look forward connecting with you as hosts or as travellers. We will do our best to make your stay truly memorable in all the right ways and also can’t wait to be great guests if we happen to chance by your Airbnb in your little corner of the globe. 

One more thought to take with you wherever you may be...

We Travel Not To Escape Life, But For Life Not To Escape Us.

See you very soon!


Mike & Panagiota x

host_about:
YOUR HOST: GARY COPOLOV 

Hello, my name is Gary and I live in Middle Park, Melbourne. I currently manage sixteen short to long term accommodation properties in Middle Park (6), Albert Park (3), South Melbourne (4), Port Melbourne (1), North Carlton (1), Torquay (1). Middle Park, Albert Park, South Melbourne and Port Melbourne. These are arguably some of Melbourne’s best inner city suburbs. I believe I am fortunate to live and manage properties in the area and meet and host wonderful guests. 

My Airbnb hosting journey started when my wife, Jo and I bought Florence Court in Nimmo Street, Middle Park in 2015. It is a heritage listed, mid 30's Art Deco apartment block in where I now offer four  fantastic short term accommodation apartments. I now operate sixteen brilliant short to long term accommodation properties in the area ranging from apartments to houses and from one to four bedrooms. They are all stunning and fitted out to the very highest standard. 

As an Airbnb Superhost I offer my guests a concierge like service. I am an unashamed ambassador for the area where I have lived for over 30 years. Just tell me your interests and I will offer my recommendations. 

Each property has a copy of "Adventures" which provides details my recommended local To Do's and the very best of nearby dining pleasures. There are many recommendations for guests of all ages. 

Jo and I met playing tennis at Kooyong Lawn Tennis Club and were married in Paris just over 28 years ago. Jo is a part time teacher at the local primary school where she is a special education reading teacher. She has a real passion for books, real estate and interior design. A typical week will see her at a local café with friends, walking our dog in the nearby park, seeing a movie, attending her book club or a yoga class. 

We have two children. Natasha (Tash) an Architecture - Design graduate working in the construction industry. When she is not out socialising or globetrotting she may occasionally walk our friendly Nova Scotia Duck Tolling Retriever called Hudson. We love pets and welcome them at all properties. 

Our son Louis lives in Portland, Maine, USA where he works for the Boston Celtics basketball team as Player Manager of their second team the Maine Celtics.  He attended university in Boston, USA and represented Australia in rowing as a coxswain. 

On weekends, given a chance, we will visit a beach side holiday apartment with stunning sea views in Torquay. Torquay is just over an hour’s drive from Melbourne. It is Victoria's surf capital and the gateway to the famous Great Ocean Road. In Torquay, we enjoy walks, great local food, wine, the many surf beaches and the company of friends. The apartment is available for stays on Airbnb. (Sleeps 8). 

We have travelled to Europe, the Middle East, South East Asia and the USA where we have enjoyed Airbnb hospitality in England, France, Italy, Spain, Bulgaria, Croatia, Turkey, Netherlands, Denmark, Sweden and the United States. I wish to share the same pleasure and the excitement of travel with my guests. 

I am a self-employed Marketing Consultant whose consultancy, Gold Medal Marketing develops and implements winning business development programs for businesses in various industries. I have written and delivered a number of business development programs. 

I am the honorary Chairman of the Australian Patients Association (APA) which advocates, educates and supports Australian patients. The APA strives to be the voice of and for Australian patients. 

I regularly attend a local gym for regular workouts which I would be pleased to introduce to my guests. 

On weekends in Winter I watch St. Kilda, an Australian Rules Football Club as a long standing and sadly long suffering club member.

With a family of designers I am always working on some property development or creative project for myself,  family and friends.

I like to catch a movie or show and visit galleries and believing that you should “be a tourist in your own town” try get out and about to something interesting either near or far. 

I look forward to sharing the great properties which I manage and my local experience with my guests. 

I am available to ensure that you have a great stay. 

Your host, 

Gary Copolov.

host_about:
Hey there you curious creatures! Time to share a little about ourselves. Mike was born and raised in New Zealand and I have a Greek background but am from a small country town in Victoria. Would you believe that in all the time we’ve been together, I haven’t been able to convince Mike to do the HAKA for me? And if you're wondering, the answer is yes...he’s an ex-rugby player and All Blacks man.

Mike trained as a chef and moved to the UK in his early 20’s to work and travel through Europe. He is a Sensei, 1st Dan black belt and passionate about teaching children the art of Karate. Mike is also a qualified landscaper, is now heavily involved in property and is one of those people who’s annoyingly good at everything.

I graduated and practiced as a Podiatrist for a couple of years, before moving into the advertising industry, security risk management and recently a furniture design & importing business. We launched our hosting journey as a way to help others create unforgettable experiences during their travels whilst having the freedom to personally explore more of our amazing world at the same time!

We’re both fans of entrepreneurship, love Gary Vaynerchuck (if you’ve never heard of him, do yourself a favour and look him up) and enjoy studying personal development, online business, the sharing economy and anything that piques our interest at the time. Podcasts, Kindle, books, online courses...we love learning new things.

Thanks for stopping by. We hope the read was worth it and so look forward connecting with you as hosts or as travellers. We will do our best to make your stay truly memorable in all the right ways and also can’t wait to be great guests if we happen to chance by your Airbnb in your little corner of the globe. 

One more thought to take with you wherever you may be...

We Travel Not To Escape Life, But For Life Not To Escape Us.

See you very soon!


Mike & Panagiota x

I started StayCentral Melbourne Corporate Apartments with one apartment, and now manage multiple properties in many different locations in inner Melbourne.

Like many of my guests, I love to travel; both overseas to places like the Mulu Caves in Borneo, ancient cities (in many old countries), Antarctica & Alaska, Patagonia, and colourful markets in amazing places like Pha Long in Vietnam, Jaisalmer in India, Tozeur in Tunisia & La Paz in Bolivia. I also love short domestic trips for weekends away just to relax. 

It means I get to be on the other side of the counter, and experience how other people look after their guests: and I take their good ideas back with me. 

I even worked as a part-time tourist guide in Melbourne for a couple of years when I arrived here, and really enjoyed the interactions with the tourists off the huge cruise liners that appear in Melbourne each spring and summer. I have tried to extend this experience into my accommodation business here in Melbourne, where I really love assisting people with their stays. You only need to read some of the 1,000 plus reviews on Airbnb, Trip Advisor, Goo gle, and on my own StayCentral Melbourne Corporate Apartments website to realise how much our guests enjoy our apartments, and the way we look after them. 

I do love living in Melbourne. It enjoys a unique place in Australia. It is often described as the cultural, business, shopping and sporting capital of the country. The restaurants and cafes in Melbourne are amongst the best in the world. I love living in an urban village amongst these, and all the other everyday shops; and jumping on a tram and avoiding the hassles of traffic. It is a city of great opportunity, experiences, events and lifestyle that can be enjoyed by locals and visitors alike; and I really enjoy facilitating our guests' stays here.

I do hope I have the opportunity to help you get to know Melbourne and grow to love it as I have. If you have any questions about StayCentral Melbourne Corporate Apartments, please feel free to call me on (Phone number hidden by Airbnb) during business hours, and I will do my best to help you.

We Travel Not To Escape Life, But For Life Not To Escape Us.

Mike & Panagiota x

Frankston, Victoria, Australia
Frankston is a busy, fast-evolving beachside suburb, located 41 km south-east of Melbourne city, north of the renowned Mornington Peninsula. Due to its geographic location, it is often referred to as 'the gateway to the Mornington Peninsula'. Situated on the eastern shoreline of Port Phillip, Frankston has been a popular seaside destination of Melbourne since the 1880s. Frankston Beach is still one of the most frequented in Victoria, and is recognised as one of the cleanest in Australia. It is also home to one of the largest exhibitions of sand sculpting in the Southern Hemisphere. The central business district (approx 1km away) is well equipped with shopping, dining options, cinemas, etc. Frankston is an affordable suburb to stay when visiting the popular Peninsula Hot Springs and local wineries. More information about what's on locally can be found at the Visit Frankston website.

Sydney Road, that great gateway to the north, could have been just another thoroughfare. But thanks to a strong sense of community, the start of the Hume Highway has become one of Melbourne’s most diverse and fascinating areas.
Its beating heart? The neighbouring suburbs of Brunswick and Coburg. While the line between these ‘hoods has become increasingly grey over time, there’s no denying that each has retained its individual charm.

The traditionally working-class areas were once a stronghold for Melbourne’s Greek and Italian migrant communities — much of that influence can still be seen today — but have since become a hub for musicians, artists and other creatives. neighborhood_overview:
HEIDELBERG -

The beauty of Heidelberg is no new revelation. The Heidelberg School, a 19th-century Australian art movement, made it famous as it was often the location for the Impressionist paintings by the likes of Arthur Streeton and Walter Withers. Artists might still paint ‘en plein air’ and use the sprawling parklands as their muse, however, these days Heidelberg is also known for its array of multicultural cafés and restaurants.

What’s Heidelberg known for?

As well as playing a central role in the Heidelberg School movement, this suburb is today known for being a premier Medical Precinct. You can find the many specialist suites, Olivia Newton John Centre, Mercy Hospital, Austin Hostipal and Warringal Hospital all in close proximity to one another.

Heidelberg is also known as being a confusing triptych of sorts with its siblings Heidelberg West and Heidelberg Heights. While these two areas are considered less popular than Heidelberg

We Travel Not To Escape Life, But For Life Not To Escape Us.

YOUR HOST: GARY COPOLOV 

Hello, my name is Gary and I live in Middle Park, Melbourne. I currently manage sixteen short to long term accommodation properties in Middle Park (6), Albert Park (3), South Melbourne (4), Port Melbourne (1), North Carlton (1), Torquay (1). Jo and I met playing tennis at Kooyong Lawn Tennis Club and were married in Paris just over 28 years ago. Jo is a part time teacher at the local primary school where she is a special education reading teacher. She has a real passion for books, real estate and interior design. A typical week will see her at a local café with friends, walking our dog in the nearby park, seeing a movie, attending her book club or a yoga class. 

We have two children. Natasha (Tash) an Architecture - Design graduate working in the construction industry. When she is not out socialising or globetrotting she may occasionally walk our friendly Nova Scotia Duck Tolling Retriever called Hudson. We love pets and welcome them at all properties. 

Our son Louis lives in Portland, Maine, USA where he works for the Boston Celtics basketball team as Player Manager of their second team the Maine Celtics.  He attended university in Boston, USA and represented Australia in rowing as a coxswain. 

On weekends, given a chance, we will visit a beach side holiday apartment with stunning sea views in Torquay. Torquay is just over an hour’s drive from Melbourne. host_about:
Hey there you curious creatures! Time to share a little about ourselves. Mike was born and raised in New Zealand and I have a Greek background but am from a small country town in Victoria. Would you believe that in all the time we’ve been together, I haven’t been able to convince Mike to do the HAKA for me? And if you're wondering, the answer is yes...he’s an ex-rugby player and All Blacks man.

I graduated and practiced as a Podiatrist for a couple of years, before moving into the advertising industry, security risk management and recently a furniture design & importing business. We launched our hosting journey as a way to help others create unforgettable experiences during their travels whilst having the freedom to personally explore more of our amazing world at the same time!

We’re both fans of entrepreneurship, love Gary Vaynerchuck (if you’ve never heard of him, do yourself a favour and look him up) and enjoy studying personal development, online business, the sharing economy and anything that piques our interest at the time. Podcasts, Kindle, books, online courses...we love learning new things.

Thanks for stopping by. We hope the read was worth it and so look forward connecting with you as hosts or as travellers. We will do our best to make your stay truly memorable in all the right ways and also can’t wait to be great guests if we happen to chance by your Airbnb in your little corner of the globe. 

One more thought to take with you wherever you may be...

We Travel Not To Escape Life, But For Life Not To Escape Us.

See you very soon!


Mike & Panagiota x

neighborhood_overview:
Prahran (also known colloquially as "Pran") is an inner suburb of Melbourne, Victoria, Australia, 5 km south-east of Melbourne's Central Business District. Prahran is a part of Greater Melbourne, with many shops, restaurants and cafes.

The shopping street Chapel Street is a mix of upscale fashion boutiques and cafes. Greville Street, once the centre of the Melbourne's hippie community, has many cafés, bars, restaurants, bookstores, clothing shops and music stores.

Prahran takes its name from Pur-ra-ran, a compound of two Aboriginal words, meaning "land partially surrounded by water". The Yalukit-willam are associated with the coastal land at the head of Port Phillip Bay that extends from the Werribee River, across to Williamstown, Port Melbourne, St. Kilda, and Prahran.

Prahran is home to a large collection of architecturally significant commercial buildings, with many on the Victorian Heritage Register.

Hey there you curious creatures! Time to share a little about ourselves. Mike was born and raised in New Zealand and I have a Greek background but am from a small country town in Victoria. One more thought to take with you wherever you may be...

We Travel Not To Escape Life, But For Life Not To Escape Us.

See you very soon!

I am trying to improve my Italian currently. Travel is now possible and very much enjoyed when Covid allows. We have developed some wonderful, close and lasting friendships with the families of many international exchange students we have hosted over the years. 
I cannot live without good leaf tea that I blend myself, my dogs, my chickens and bees and I adore my garden. 
My reading is voracious and covers many genres - just not fantasy or science fiction!
When you stay with us you will be warmly welcomed and nurtured but allowed your privacy and seclusion. I like to give you a loaf of home made bread, fresh eggs from "the girls" and some home grown and made jam. 
You have a stylish apartment with the highest quality furnishings and bedding to ensure your comfort with direct access to a private outdoor sitting area and the swimming pool and tennis court.  I hope you will feel nurtured. 
Our style of travelling is to seek out different styles of accomodation and to pursue the friendships, language and cultures that have given us so much joy and pleasure. Travelling is about places and experiences but more importantly about the human interactions and friendships that develop when one is open to them. 
I have always been a "pay it forward" kind of person. I like to think by our everyday actions we can make life just a little better for others. And that's a good thing.

host_about: Tiny Away spearheads the tiny house eco-tourism in Australia.
